cards.card_text: The writer says it's in the Book of Jashar too: "So the sun stopped in the middle of the sky and delayed going down about a full day."
cards.verse_text: Is this not written in the Book of Jashar?
cards.snippet: Is this not written in the Book of Jashar?

cards.card_text: The song is written in the Book of Jashar, and it opens with Israel's glory lying slain on the heights.
cards.verse_text: It is written in the Book of Jashar: “Your glory, O Israel, lies slain on your heights.
